description: [Requires sign-in] Ask benchmark personal-agent personas what they think of a brand and whether they would recommend it for a category. Personas A to E are ARC benchmark personas named by how they shop: A always-on errands, B errands by text, C researches on its own computer, D works toward a goal, E self-hosted. None of them is a consumer AI product or a live consumer-product session. Persona C runs on a Grok model via API. It is not the real Grok read-back on a scan and it is not the agent-rai

category.description: Product category a shopper would ask about, e.g. running shoes.

competitors.description: Optional competitor brand names to watch for in the answers.

name: arcreport__ask_agents_about_brand
